rep.name: Wave
rep.challenge: Breather: a wave-shaped bar lies on three rings. Free each of its rest points; the rings below it free themselves.

rep.name: Gears
rep.challenge: Turn one gear and its partner turns the other way. Find the direction where both gaps reach their pins.

rep.name: Drawbridge
rep.challenge: The bridge bar rests on two gears. One turn of a gear frees both ends together, if the free arms do not hit the bridge first.

rep.name: Partner
rep.challenge: The orange gear looks free but only shakes: its partner still hooks the purple ring. Free purple first, then turn the pair the way that keeps the free arm off the pin.

rep.name: Gear train
rep.challenge: Three gears turn as one, the middle one the other way, but the middle gear is locked. Get its key from the top chain. The bomb on the right gear must reach the closed knot below before the gears let go of their pins: one direction does both, the other wastes the bomb.

rep.name: Nest
rep.challenge: Breather: small rings sit inside big ones and hook their inner side. Turn the big rings so their gaps pass the inner hooks.

rep.name: Crossfire
rep.challenge: Each bomb ring sits next to the wrong knot: the near hit is on a free ring. Clear the bar first so each bomb can reach across.

rep.name: Clock
rep.challenge: Four small gears sit around a big gear. The clock hands are bars resting on the gears: one turn of the big gear moves all four the other way.

rep.name: Lift
rep.challenge: The key sits on a gear pair. Turn the pair to drop it, then the locked cabin ring and its chain can move.

rep.name: Grid
rep.challenge: Nine rings in a grid, linked like a maze, a locked center and a frame of pinned bars. Find the one corner that starts the chain.
